text:
pat_billing: SkylineAI flagged invoice INV-SKY-2026-04 — they say a 2.5h DR failover to ap-northeast generated burst charges even though sales says they expected reserved failover. asking for breakdown + remediation.

maria_finance: paste invoice id + any meter lines you have. need to verify burst vs reserved buckets.

pat_billing: INV-SKY-2026-04 attached. quote from customer: 'we failed over during an APAC outage on 2026-04-09; saw ~14% overage vs commit.'

sam_ops: quick look — their reserved commit is scoped to eu-west + us-east, not APAC. our routing will only use reserved nodes in the region of the origin unless configured for multi-region reserved mirroring. fallback uses shared burst.

chloe_prod: do we have a product note where sales promised "preserved reserved capacity on failover"? that sounds like a risky promise.

ivan_sales: we showed architecture in the demo that implied DR would be seamless; not explicit in contract. customer believes we should have preserved reserved capacity. we need to handle this carefully.

sam_ops: pulled sanitized metering lines for the window:
```
meter: customer=skylineai region=ap-northeast bucket=burst tokens=410000 ts=2026-04-09T11:12:09Z
meter: customer=skylineai region=ap-northeast bucket=burst tokens=220000 ts=2026-04-09T12:05:33Z
meter: customer=skylineai region=eu-west bucket=reserved tokens=1_600_000 ts=2026-04-09T09:50:00Z
```

sam_ops: ap-northeast burst total ~630k tokens. that matches their ~14% delta.

maria_finance: what's the burst unit price for their tier?

pat_billing: enterprise negotiated burst = $0.0047/token.

maria_finance: provisional credit calc = 630000 * 0.0047 = $2,961. propose provisional goodwill credit while ops investigates. request CFO ok.

laura_cfo: i can approve provisional credit up to $3k for CX reasons. require full token math, meter export link, and final RCA before we book as SLA credit or reverse.

ivan_sales: i'll join the customer call and frame this as a one-time remediation while we clarify the contract. want to keep trust high.

chloe_prod: product follow-up: we should add an explicit "multi-region reserved" flag customers can enable and surface in the console. also add a billing tag for "DR-investigation" to prevent auto-invoicing while open. raising PROD-5331.

sam_ops: opened OPS-6450 to audit routing for SkylineAI and add a billing-exception flag for failover windows. ETA 48h. will check whether policy change would have routed to reserved nodes or if this is expected behavior given their config.

metering-bot: export ready: s3://redwood-metering/exports/skylineai/2026-04-09/1919191919-export.csv

pat_billing: drafting customer message: "Thanks — we're reviewing the failover window on 2026-04-09. We will apply a provisional credit of $2,961 while we investigate; final outcome subject to RCA. Expect update within 48h." ok?

maria_finance: include 'subject to final RCA' and the exact token math in the note.

pat_billing: will add math and send. applying provisional credit now and tagging INV-SKY-2026-04 as under review.

laura_cfo: please ensure the credit memo references OPS-6450 and attaches the metering export when complete. i'll sign off final entry after RCA.

ivan_sales: leaving a note for the customer call: keep it technical and avoid legalese; offer to review console settings for multi-region reserved.

pat_billing: credit applied $2,961. sending hold note to SkylineAI. leaving thread open until OPS-6450 closes. :white_check_mark:
